\n[b]Звёздные врата.[/b] Вершина завода:: [b]Star Gate.[/b] The pinnacle of the factory: superconductors, star alloy, fusion cells, quantum cores, antimatter and dark matter lenses for the 5 stages of the megaproject.
\n[b]Инженерный стол.[/b] Разложите пред: [b]Engineering table.[/b] Arrange items in a 4×4 pattern: the hint counts matching cells. The right pattern permanently unlocks an improved recipe (arc steel, dense boards, helium from waste…).
\n[b]Квантовое измерение (после атома).[: [b]Quantum dimension (after the atom).[/b] The quantum portal (needs power) creates veins in superposition: look at a vein up close and it chooses what to become; in the portal window free veins can be returned to superposition for a shard. Entangled crates share the same contents at any distance, entangled stations form one network. Quantum shades move only while you are not looking: keep them in view.
\n[b]НЛО-торговля.[/b] Постройте посадоч: [b]UFO trade.[/b] Build a landing pad, put goods into "Input", order exotics (helium-3, antimatter, neutronium…). The UFO arrives on schedule, takes the goods and brings your order next time. Rates change every day: catch a good one.
\n[b]Новые ресурсы по дереву открытий.[/: [b]New resources in the tech tree.[/b] "Chemistry": saltpeter and gunpowder (ammo is now made from gunpowder; crude ammo from ingots and coal). "Acids": chemical plant, sulfuric acid, acid-proof pipes. "Aluminum": alunite → alumina solution → scrap → ingots. "Uranium" and "Nuclear power": uranium ore, centrifuge, fuel rods and the nuclear plant.
\n[b]Опасно![/b] Кислота разъедает обычн: [b]Danger![/b] Acid eats through normal pipes and tanks (you need acid-proof or Mk4 ones), and a burst pipe leaves a burning puddle. Uranium, uranium deposits and fuel rods are radioactive: watch the dosimeter on the left and wear a protective suit.
\n[b]Поле зрения.[/b] Вы видите только т: [b]Field of view.[/b] You only see what is in front of the hero. Monsters behind you are invisible and buildings there are dimmed: look around!
\n[b]Сборное здание (до %d в одном).[/b]: [b]Composite building (up to %d in one).[/b] First place a base (drill, furnace or assembler), then another building right next to it (crate, generator, battery, assembler, turret). "Combine into one building?" appears: press "Build in". Or open the base ([b]%s[/b]) and press "Build in '…' (nearby)". The built-in part disappears from the ground and becomes part of the base; place the next one next to the base again. A drill is always the base and cannot be built into another. Inside: drill → furnace → assembler → crate; generators and batteries power it without wires, turrets and shields sit on the roof.
\n[b]Станция дронов.[/b] Поставьте станц: [b]Drone station.[/b] Place a station, open it ([b]%s[/b]) → "+ Add route" → click the building to take from (A), then where to deliver (B). Drones fly on their own and recharge and repair at the station. Merge stations: level 2 has 2 drones, 3 has 4, 4 has 8, 5 has 15.
\n[b]Тонкая настройка (по желанию).[/b]: [b]Fine-tuning (optional).[/b] Furnaces, drills, pumps, assemblers, generators, the chemical plant, centrifuge, turrets, panels and wind turbines have a dial in their window.
